summary: Oatly Group AB filed a Form 6-K furnishing its press release for Q1 2026 financial results. No merger, acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC transaction, or abrupt management change is disclosed. The filing is a routine earnings release for a foreign private issuer, reporting revenue of $228.3 million and net loss of $12.0 million, with no special-situation event. Therefore, no further analysis applies.
